text.tspan: C43 / R25: series capacitor separated from grounded resistor.
C44 / R26: series capacitor separated from grounded resistor.
Both grounded resistors join their capacitors with continuous wires.
Same scale, symbols and pin connections. C44 also rotated to fix the existing flip finding; the
three other RC branches are aligned below.
